events.title: Sticky Rooms is taking part in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: From October 19 to 26, the Sticky Rooms: A hopeful illusion demo is available as part of Steam Next Fest.Furniture in this game comes as stickers. You place it on the room and there it stays: put the table down before the rug and the rug no longer fits underneath. There’s no undo.
